generationInputs.prompt: A digitally created image features a central illustration of a clenched fist. The fist has a light reddish-brown skin tone and is wrapped with a glowing blue electrical cord. The cord originates from behind the fist, wraps around the forearm and hand, and extends upward. Behind the fist is a stylized representation of a brain, divided into two halves. The left half of the brain is outlined in a bright red neon light, while the right half is outlined in a vibrant purple neon light. Above the brain and fist, the words "FISTING CIENCIA" are written in a simple, uppercase white font. Below the brain and fist, the words "FISTING ONCCENCIA" are written in the same style. The background is a dark, speckled purple, suggesting a night sky or a cosmic setting with scattered light particles. The overall lighting effect is dramatic, with the neon outlines and the glowing cord contrasting against the dark background.
